status: frozen before any X14-1b run; this file is committed and pushed before the experiment code for X14-1b is run
purpose: redesign of X14-1 after STOP: test Fragility Transfer only where the intervention verifiably improves its own organization, with uncapped metrics, 10 seeds and two embodiments

configurations.xeno14: module-wise training (round-robin, each module on survival − 0.5·normalized own metric), 48 ES iterations
configurations.xeno14-scalarized-training: same architecture, all parameters on the scalarized objective, 48 iterations
configurations.xeno14-gates-off: same architecture without ignition gates, module-wise training, 48 iterations
configurations.multiobjective-scalarized-mlp: MLP on the scalarized objective, 48 iterations

optimizer: antithetic ES, 8 pairs (16 episodes) per iteration, sigma 0.05, Adam lr 0.03 — identical for all
training_pushes: 0 / ±80 N on the torso, 5 steps from step 100 (same absolute force for both embodiments)
evaluation: 10 episodes per push level (0, ±80, ±140 N) on held-out seeds; metrics are raw (uncapped) organization metrics averaged over surviving steps, survival fraction, recovered fraction

interventions.xeno14: I_i: 24 ES iterations on module i with its own objective; control C: 24 iterations of the round-robin schedule (8 per module)
interventions.tradeoff: scalarized MLP — I_i: 24 iterations on the emphasis objective (weight 3 on i, 1 on the others); control C: 24 iterations on the scalarized objective

ft_definition: FT[i][j] = (m_j(I_i) − m_j(C)) / m_j(C) per seed; primary push 140 N, secondary 80 N; positive = organization j deteriorates
uncertainty: bootstrap over seeds, 10 000 resamples (numpy default_rng(0)), 95% percentile interval
self_improvement_criterion: row i is interpretable only if the 95% interval of FT[i][i] lies entirely below 0
transfer_declared: in an interpretable row, FT[i][j] (j ≠ i) with a 95% interval entirely above 0 (deterioration) or entirely below 0 (co-improvement)
adds_information_beyond_tradeoff: a declared Xeno-14 entry (i, j) for which the trade-off matrix does not declare the same sign for (i, j) (including a non-interpretable trade-off row)

hypotheses.H1: Walker2d, 140 N: FT[low-noise-movement][axis-maintenance] > 0 and FT[low-noise-movement][lower-abdominal-continuity] > 0 with row low-noise-movement interpretable (derived from the X14-1 exploratory analysis)
hypotheses.H2: morphology dependence: at least one declared entry differs in sign or declaration between embodiments, or an ignition fraction differs (95% interval of the difference excludes 0)

paired_comparisons: survival at 140 N, paired by seed, bootstrap 95% interval of the difference: xeno14 − xeno14-scalarized-training, xeno14 − xeno14-gates-off, xeno14 − multiobjective-scalarized-mlp, xeno14 − standard-mlp
ignition_consistency: per module, the across-seed standard deviation of the ignition fraction (gate > 0.5) at 80 N; consistent if < 0.25

decision_rule.GO: (a) at least one declared transfer in an interpretable row in some embodiment, (b) at least one such entry adds information beyond the trade-off analysis, (c) the interval of xeno14 − xeno14-scalarized-training survival is not entirely below 0, and (d) at least one module has consistent ignition in each embodiment

not_repeated: architecture repartition (X14-1 result inconclusive; deferred to a separate protocol)
known_biases: organization metrics are averaged over surviving steps, so earlier falls shorten the averaging window; survival is reported alongside every metric
post_hoc: any change after the run is an exploratory follow-up that does not replace these results
